**Dark Eyes: Battle Gate** is a 2001 strategy RPG for the WonderSwan Color by Nextech. It was released only in Japan.

On the planet Fairhope, two peoples live side by side: the Orghal, the Sun Folk, who built machines and ki arts, and the Infan, the Wind Folk, who forged sorcery in a harsh land. A fragile truce holds while an evil god's cult stirs in the shadows. You pick a side, Orghal or Infan, and lead your party through tactical battles on isometric maps, with class changes, mercenaries and "mind games" (cheer, scare, daze, persuade).

> **Please read:** this translation was made **entirely with AI**, as a personal project. It is shared as it is for anyone who wants to play, but it must **never be uploaded to romhacking sites** (romhacking.net and the like). It isn't up to the standard of a real fan translation and doesn't belong there.

**How to patch**

Two versions with the same translation: normal (mixed case) and ALL CAPS. Apply the .bps to *Dark Eyes - Battle Gate (Japan).wsc* (4 MB, CRC32 12AE932C) with Floating IPS, beat or ROM Patcher JS. The result is 8 MB, CRC32 CBE53CBF (normal) or 31020981 (ALL CAPS); keep the .wsc extension.

With Floating IPS on the command line:

    flips --apply "Dark.Eyes.-.Battle.Gate.EN.v0.9.bps" "Dark Eyes - Battle Gate (Japan).wsc" "Dark Eyes - Battle Gate (EN v0.9).wsc"
    flips --apply "Dark.Eyes.-.Battle.Gate.EN.v0.9.ALL.CAPS.bps" "Dark Eyes - Battle Gate (Japan).wsc" "Dark Eyes - Battle Gate (EN v0.9, ALL CAPS).wsc"
